game.title: Wasteland 3
game.blurb: Party-based, turn-based tactical RPG set in the frozen wastes of Colorado, from inXile Entertainment, released 2020-08-28. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The Rangers' mission in Colorado, its factions and its many endings. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Beating the game on each difficulty, from the easiest to the hardest.

chapters.title: Exploration, Ranger HQ and Collections
chapters.summary: The World Map, Ranger HQ upgrades, the vehicle, animal companions, cassette tapes, toys and other oddities.

chapters.title: The Battle of Steeltown
chapters.summary: The Steeltown story and settling its problems with or without bloodshed. Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Squad and Combat
chapters.summary: Levelling up, weapon mods, cyborg parts, elemental kills, explosives and big fights.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 719040)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Wasteland_3
Fandom (wasteland.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://wasteland.fandom.com/wiki/Wasteland_3
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. wasteland.fandom.com answers the API, with about 26 linked pages, including "Battle of Steeltown", "Cult of the Holy Detonation" and "Wasteland 3 quests"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG also lists "Wasteland 3: The Battle of Steeltown" as a separate entry. 55 of 86 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Achievements 63 to 69 are hidden but sit in the schema right before the two visible Steeltown achievements (70 and 71), and the first is named "Steeltown Defiant", so all seven were placed in the Steeltown chapter by name; that is a judgement call. Hidden achievements 72 to 86 (for example "God Killer", "Candy", "Kumbaya") are a later block, all earned by under 8% of players; they may belong to the other add-on named on Fandom ("Cult of the Holy Detonation"), but no achievement text says so, so they sit in the main story chapter with the other hidden ones as a placeholder. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks low.
